title: Build plan: quiet unattended mode
approval: Build plan approved: quiet unattended mode

short.lead: Eleven steps build the approved quiet unattended mode, each with its issue and its own test, and I need one approval line from you.
short.hint: Tap a step to see it.
items: Rewrite the rule lines that ask, wait or hand over (#635 Rewrite the rule lines that tell me to ask, wait or hand over).

items.alt: The eleven build steps in order
items.caption: The build order

items: One helper says who is present; guards use it (#636 One test for who is present, and the guards that use it).
decide, park rules, deviate rules, check (#638 Ledger rows for decisions, and rules for parking and deviating).
Unattended keeps the design loop on (#637 Keep the design loop on when nobody is present).
Guarded step list and four finish steps (#639 A guarded step list with four required finish-line steps).
Block every stop while a step is open (#640 A stop check on every stop that blocks while a step is open).
A hook approves with a stored verdict (#641 Self-approval by a hook, backed by a stored reviewer verdict).
overnight.sh resumes by session id (#642 A restart loop in the overnight launcher).
Decisions go to the ledger, not the reply (#643 Show decisions only on the QA page).
Update pinned tests, reversals, docs, version (#645 Tests, docs, reversed decisions and version bump).
A real headless unattended run (#644 Live headless unattended run and acceptance).

changes: Rewrite the rule lines that ask, wait or hand over
Done when: Rule lines no longer say ask or wait outside look-or-function and hard stops; the injected-rules size check passes.
One helper says who is present; guards use it
Done when: Cases for unattended, bypass, auto, normal and unknown pass at every old call site; a prompt is denied at once; an agent write to the mode file is refused.
decide, park rules, deviate rules, check
Done when: A C row shows first on a QA page; park is refused with no category; deviate is refused when it deletes a step.
Unattended keeps the design loop on
Done when: The listed end-of-reply checks run when unattended; the three holds are skipped when nobody is present and unchanged when attended.
Guarded step list and four finish steps
Done when: The step file carries matching hashes; a step is done only after a passing check; the four finish steps cannot be parked, replaced or deleted.
Block every stop while a step is open
Done when: A stop with an open step is blocked, even with no reply text; three no-progress blocks mark a step stuck; NEEDS YOU text exempts nothing.
A hook approves with a stored verdict
Done when: Approval is recorded only with a matching verdict; it is refused in auto and normal mode and for QA passed; the newest-approval marker is unchanged.
Done when: tools/verify_tools.py cases show resume by id, a rate-limit wait that spends no restart, the two limits ending into a QA pass, and the interactive flag.
Decisions go to the ledger, not the reply
Done when: A guard refusal and a denied question each write a ledger row and no Waiting-on-you or final-report instruction.
Update pinned tests, reversals, docs, version
Done when: Both full test commands exit 0, docref.py check and docs_drift.py pass, and each of the twelve reversals has its dated Decisions.md entry.
Done when: The transcript shows self-approval, a forced early stop resumed, a look-or-function assumption logged, the four finish steps done and a QA page with decisions first.
One test per design item, run in step 11 and saved under docs/qa/quiet-unattended-mode/.

Done when each passes with evidence saved: C1 rule lines; C2 presence by mode; C3 loop on; C4 self-approval; C5 step list; C6 finish line; C7 stop check; C8 look-or-function assumption; C9 restart loop; C10 QA-only reporting; C11 gates skipped; C12 reversals and docs.
